name: Deploy SCC Air Quality Website

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

  push:
    branches:
      - main

  schedule:
    - cron: '0 3 * * 1'

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install rsync and sshpass
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y rsync sshpass

      - name: Detect Website Directory
        id: detect
        run: |
          if [ -d "website" ]; then
            echo "dir=website" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          elif [ -d "docs" ]; then
            echo "dir=docs" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "dir=." >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Validate Website Content
        env:
          WEBSITE_DIR: ${{ steps.detect.outputs.dir }}
        run: |
          echo "Using website directory: ${WEBSITE_DIR}"
          ls -lah ${WEBSITE_DIR}

          if [ ! -f "${WEBSITE_DIR}/index.html" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: index.html missing"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Deploy Website To Hostinger
        env:
          HOST: ${{ secrets.SCCAIRQUALITY_SSH_HOST }}
          USER: ${{ secrets.SCCAIRQUALITY_SSH_USERNAME }}
          PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SCCAIRQUALITY_SSH_PASSWORD }}
          PORT: ${{ secrets.SCCAIRQUALITY_SSH_PORT }}
          TARGET: ${{ secrets.AIRQUALITY_HOSTINGER_PUBLIC_HTML_DIR }}
          WEBSITE_DIR: ${{ steps.detect.outputs.dir }}
        run: |
          echo "Deploying ${WEBSITE_DIR} to ${HOST}:${TARGET}"

          sshpass -p "$PASSWORD" rsync \
            -avz \
            --exclude 'unredacted/' \
            --exclude 'test/' \
            --exclude '.htaccess' \
            --omit-dir-times \
            --no-perms \
            --no-owner \
            --no-group \
            -e "ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -p $PORT" \
            ${WEBSITE_DIR}/ \
            ${USER}@${HOST}:${TARGET}/

      - name: Fix Permissions
        env:
          HOST: ${{ secrets.SCCAIRQUALITY_SSH_HOST }}
          USER: ${{ secrets.SCCAIRQUALITY_SSH_USERNAME }}
          PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SCCAIRQUALITY_SSH_PASSWORD }}
          PORT: ${{ secrets.SCCAIRQUALITY_SSH_PORT }}
          TARGET: ${{ secrets.AIRQUALITY_HOSTINGER_PUBLIC_HTML_DIR }}
        run: |
          sshpass -p "$PASSWORD" ssh \
            -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no \
            -p $PORT \
            ${USER}@${HOST} \
            "find ${TARGET} -type d -exec chmod 755 {} \\\; && find ${TARGET} -type f -exec chmod 644 {} \\\;"

      - name: Verify Deployment
        run: |
          echo "Deployment completed successfully"
